params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: landing-feedback  Priority: P2  Area: site
Summary: The landing page carries too much. It should state one easy message about what Bextrust does, with a sense of urgency and of what is lost without it, keep every other message short and point to the section that explains it, and stay simple on a phone.

## What is asked
- One central message. The proposal is to reuse the client's own text that now opens Services, verbatim: "Your access point to trusted issuance, verification and records. We are the trust-enablement layer for our clients: the access point to regulated blockchain networks, the support to configure and assess your use case, and the tools to test it before production..."
- The rest of the current landing content (the "we are the gateway" story) moves to the Infrastructure page as its opener.
- Short blocks with signposts to Infrastructure, Services, How we work.
- A mobile-first, simple layout.
- Reach beyond Belgium while keeping Belgium visible as the home base.

## Notes
- Copy written by the client stays verbatim; any new connecting lines are flagged as new copy in the PR.
- ISBE is not qualified yet: the landing page makes no claim of an EU trust mark or of legal presumption.

Source: Portal mail:6 (feedback on the website content, forwarded by the owner). The client asks for the owner's view first, so this is a proposal to agree on before building.
params.title: Landing page: one short central message with signposts, mobile-first
